$comment: Friends you split with: the picker, the split screen's friends, a friend's page, the To split queue (DATA.md rule 23).

add.note: Row that creates a friend with the name typed.

pick.empty: Type a name to add your first friend.

withEvent.note: One-tap suggestion while an event or trip with people runs; names are "Ola, Max".

you.note: Section header over your own parts once friends are in the split.

owes.note: Section header over the friends' shares on the split screen.

edit.note: Link beside the friends header: opens the people picker to add or remove friends.

fixed.note: Caption: this friend's amount was typed rather than an equal share.

items.note: The items a friend had, joined with commas: "Lamp, beer".

friendA11y.note: VoiceOver label of a friend's row.

noteLine.note: Line added to the entry's note; list is "Ola 40,00 PLN, Max 40,00 PLN".

howMuch.note: Title over the calculator for a friend's share.

title.note: Title of the items list for one friend's share.

items.intro: List what was only theirs. The rest is shared equally.
items.name: Item

youOwe.note: Over a friend's balance when they paid more than their shares.

share.note: A history line without a shop name.

repaid.note: A history line for money from the friend.

after.note: Running balance after a history line; amount is "85,00 PLN".

letGoBody.message: {amount} that {name} still owes becomes your own spending, under the category of what it was for.

remindText.note: Message sent from the share sheet; lines are "Bistro, 7 Nov: 40,00 PLN" one per line.

remindLine.note: One line of the reminder message.

page.removeBody: Their history stays in your entries, under no name.
page.noAccount: Add an account in this currency first.

share.note: In place of a category on a friend's share of a purchase.

repaid.note: In place of a category on money from a friend.

title.note: Section header on the Debts screen and the Budgets card.

owes.note: Under a friend's name; amount is "40,00 PLN".

owed.note: Under a friend's name when you owe them.

and.note: Joins the last two first names in a group's name: "Ola, Max & Ira".

make.note: Link beside the Friends header on Debts: pick friends to keep together.

edit.note: Row under an opened group on Debts.

owe.note: Under a group's name; amount is "40,00 PLN".

owed.note: Under a group's name when you owe them.

reorderSection.note: Subtitle of the Owed to you section on the Budgets reorder screen.

debts.note: Line on the card for the debts screen.

card.toSplit: {count, plural, one {# payment to split} other {# payments to split}}

later.note: Header button on the split screen: save the entry marked to split later.

title.note: Screen of payments marked to be split later.

mark.note: Chip on the entry sheet that marks the payment for the To split queue.

toSplit.markedA11y: Marked to split later. Tap to unmark.
toSplit.emptyHint: Mark a payment with “Split later” on its entry, and it waits here.

people.note: Row on the trip/event sheet that picks the friends.

deleteShares.message: Also delete {count, plural, one {the friend’s share} other {# friends’ shares}}?
deleteShares.note: Asked when deleting a purchase that friends' shares were carved from.

event.deleteSharesBody: They would otherwise still owe you for it.
